ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth security harness designed specifically to evaluate and harden LLM-based applications against sophisticated prompt injection and data exfiltration challenges commonly found in AI-themed CTF categories.
ideas.title: PromptShield CTF Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of defense-in-depth and hardening principles seen in successful security challenges, providing an automated tool for judges to test LLM robustness.

ideas.pitch: An automated security insights and vulnerability report generator that parses codebases for secret leaks, hardcoded credentials, and insecure cryptographic configurations during high-pressure CTF code-audit challenges.
ideas.title: RepoSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of automated repository summary and security insight tools that directly appeal to judges looking for practical workflow accelerators in software security.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge authentication gateway that enables capture-the-flag platforms to verify competitor progression and solve states without revealing the underlying flag payload or exploit scripts.
ideas.title: CryptoGate Zero-Knowledge Access Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced cryptographic verification primitives similar to winning ZK projects, demonstrating high technical difficulty suited for a cybersecurity-focused hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A real-time communication analysis pipeline using fine-tuned BERT models to instantly detect and flag phishing URLs, social engineering emails, and malicious SMS payloads submitted during OSINT challenges.
ideas.title: PhishGuard BERT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows a proven runner-up pattern from cybersecurity hackathons by combining natural language processing with practical threat intelligence detection.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic engagement gateway for analyzing jammed or compromised wireless IoT and drone communication protocols at the edge, featuring human-in-the-loop manual override for security analysts.
ideas.title: EdgeSentry Anti-UAS Protocol Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly embodies hard engineering and defense-tech principles praised in competition wins for resilience under adversarial network conditions.
